jobs.occupation: Freelance Medior Software Test Engineer | Banking & Financial Services
jobs.description:
Are you a Software Tester with a keen eye for detail and a passion for quality?

For one of our clients in the financial services sector, we are looking for a motivated and analytical Medior Software Test Engineer with 3–5 years of professional experience.

You will join a dynamic IT environment where you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability and functionality of banking applications.

You will collaborate closely with Developers, Business Analysts, UX/UI Specialists and other IT professionals within an Agile/Scrum environment.

What Will You Be Doing?

As a Software Test Engineer, you will ensure that applications meet functional requirements, acceptance criteria and business expectations.

Your key responsibilities:

• Analyse business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
• Design, document and execute functional test cases and test scenarios.
• Identify, analyse, report and track software defects throughout their lifecycle.
• Collaborate with Developers and Business Analysts to investigate and resolve issues.
• Validate application functionality against business requirements.
• Monitor testing activities and software development progress.
• Actively participate in Scrum ceremonies, daily stand-ups and team meetings.
• Contribute to product backlog discussions and prioritisation.
• Work with testers across different teams to continuously improve testing processes.
• Contribute to the overall quality and reliability of financial applications.

What Are We Looking For?

• 3–5 years of professional experience in software testing or functional testing.
• Hands-on experience with Jira, Xray or similar test management tools.
• Good knowledge of SQL and data validation techniques.
• Experience designing, executing and documenting test cases.
• Strong understanding of defect management and bug tracking.
• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and software development processes.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Proactive, independent and collaborative mindset.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Good professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
Nice to have:

• Previous experience in banking, investment or financial services.
• Understanding of financial products and banking applications.
• Experience improving testing processes and quality standards.

Your expertise in the Belgian insurance market, on a long-term assignment with a software vendor serving the country’s leading insurers.

Business Analyst Insurance | Freelance | Brussels

Our client is an international software vendor whose insurance division develops a modular solution covering the entire insurance value chain: distribution, policy management, claims and accounting.

What makes it stand out? A human-sized Belgian team on the insurance side, backed by an international organisation and by product and development teams of several thousand people.

The Belgian market is a strategic priority for the group, which already counts major clients there. Contracts are signed for long periods, often around ten years, giving freelancers real continuity of assignment.

With a growing project portfolio, the company is looking for several freelance Business Analysts specialised in insurance.

All of this within a hybrid and flexible organisation, anchored in Brussels.

The job

• Assigned to a client project, you hold a central role between the insurer, its business teams and the vendor’s engineering teams.
• Understand the client’s needs, challenge them and match them against the capabilities of the solution.
• Analyse the gap between the client’s processes and the standard product, then identify the required configurations or customisations.
• Work on one or more modules depending on your specialisation: group life, individual life, non-life, and potentially claims or finance.
• Be operational from day one and bring your knowledge of the Belgian market straight into the project.
 
Role
• Gather, analyse and challenge the business needs of insurance clients.
• Carry out the gap analysis between the client’s processes and the standard functionalities of the solution.
• Identify and formalise the configurations and customisations to be implemented.
• Translate business needs into clear functional requirements that engineering teams can work with.
• Ensure the day-to-day link between the client’s business stakeholders and the product and development teams.
• Work within your area of specialisation: group life, individual life or non-life insurance.
• Support the configuration and implementation of the solution throughout the project.
• Take part in functional validation and testing of delivered developments.
• Relay Belgian market developments and client expectations to the product teams.
• For the most specialised profiles, contribute to modules deployed across several clients.
Profile
• Freelancer with experience directly tied to the Belgian insurance market: banking experience alone is not sufficient for this role.
• Around 5 to 10 years of business experience, with the ability to be operational immediately, without a training period.
• Proven expertise in one specialisation: group life insurance (including employee benefits), individual life or non-life.
• Experience with an insurer, with a consultancy active in the sector, or with a software vendor specialised in insurance.
• Good knowledge of developments in the Belgian market, particularly local legislation and insurers’ expectations.
• Ability to translate these business stakes into concrete requirements for engineering teams.
• Excellent interpersonal skills and ease with a wide range of stakeholders, from business teams to management.
• Full autonomy and the ability to take ownership of your scope from the start.
• English is essential for working with the international teams, complemented by French or Dutch depending on the client.
